items.exampleZh: 我們來討論這個計畫吧。

items.exampleEn: Please check your bag before you leave.
items.exampleZh: 離開前請檢查你的包包。

items.exampleEn: Guess what I have in my hand!
The dog shakes its body after a swim.
items.exampleZh: 狗游完泳後抖一抖身體。

items.audioEn: Guess how old I am. I am forty!
items.audioZh: 猜猜我幾歲，我四十歲了！

items.sentenceEn: Shake the bottle before you drink.
Mom always checks the windows before bed.
items.sentenceZh: 媽媽睡前總會檢查窗戶。

items.stemEn: ____ you can fly. Where do you want to go?
items.stemZh: 想像你會飛，你想去哪裡？

items.stemEn: Waiter, can we have the ____, please? We want to pay.
items.stemZh: 服務生，請給我們帳單，我們要結帳。

items.passageEn: After dinner at a quiet restaurant, my family discusses the food. My dad says the fish was the best. My little sister makes a funny face, and we all laugh. Then Dad asks for the check. "Guess how much it is," he says. Mom says, "I can't imagine!"
items.passageZh: 在一家安靜的餐廳吃完晚餐後，我們全家討論起食物。爸爸說魚最好吃。妹妹做了個鬼臉，我們都笑了。接著爸爸請服務生拿帳單來，說：「猜猜看多少錢。」媽媽說：「我不敢想像！」

questions.questionZh: 晚餐後全家人在討論什麼？

rubricZh: forget 後面可直接接名詞，或接 to＋原形（例如 forget to study）
finish 後面接名詞或動名詞（例如 finish your homework）
問是否完成可寫，例如 Did you finish…、Have you finished… 等
